content:
Elena: Heads up — GreenThumb Agro just signed a 12-month Dedicated contract and agreed to a Private (VPC) pilot with FieldWorks as the systems integrator. They passed security review today and want enablement next week. :tada:
Raj: Amazing news, congrats team! Big ups to @natalie-cs for the enterprise push. What’s the go-live timeline?
Elena: Pilot start targeted in 2 weeks (2025-04-12). GreenThumb wants telemetry + per-route cost reports and a canary rollout for model updates.
Marta: I can draft the canary rollout playbook and sample config for their sequence lengths/throughput. Assigning myself to the eval hooks.
Sacha: I’ll prep Dedicated capacity sizing + a KV cache plan. Need expected QPS — Raj, can you confirm traffic patterns?
Raj: @Sacha they’re starting at ~800 requests/min with burst to 2k for harvest windows. We sold a buffer for autoscale but they asked for stricter latency SLOs.
natalie-cs: I’ll run the onboarding call and collect final compliance items. Also lined up a co-marketing webinar with FieldWorks in ~3 weeks. Draft case study is at https://docs.internal.redwood/case-studies/green-thumb-draft — please review.
tim-ops: Noted. I’ll provision the VPC peering and HSM key integration. ETA: 4 business days once we get firewall CIDRs.
Sacha: Quick note on model variants: recommend shipping a quantized rlhf-lite variant as fallback to meet latency targets — I’ll post perf numbers in the doc.
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket RD-5982 created for GreenThumb Dedicated onboarding (owner: Sacha).
Elena: Thanks everyone — great cross-functional work. @Raj please loop legal on the co-sell terms, @natalie-cs ping me when the case study is ready for review. Will share a short announcement for partners channel once webinar date is locked. :rocket:
